key.doc: The item one call costs: one key per banner (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §5).

heroChance.doc: The chance a call brings a whole hero, before soft pity ramps it (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §6.3).

duplicateFragments.doc: Fragments a hero already held turns into: the price of a recruit.

showsHero.doc: The store's Heroes tab stands a hero on this banner: one of the rarest rarity it can call, a different one each time the store is opened, every one before any repeats. Off: the banner shows its key.

lootDrawsMin.doc: The fewest prizes a call draws from `loot`, hero or not (Docs/features/10-heroes.md §6.4).

lootDrawsMax.doc: The most prizes a call draws from `loot`. Each count from min to max is as likely.

loot.doc: What a call draws its prizes from, by weight — every call, hero or not.

reward.doc: Fragments: of one hero of `rarity` this banner calls. Stardust, HeroXp: into the wallet. Item: `item` into the Bag.

rarity.doc: Fragments: whose. Empty for anything else.

item.doc: Item: which. Empty for anything else.

weight.doc: Its share of the draws, against the rest of the list.
